worldcombat.skill.steelwing.summary: Spread the hard wings to either side and cut with the two real wing edges: whoever each left or right edge touches takes one contact hit and is shoved, while the gap straight ahead between the wings stays safe. The first landed hit may harden the wing and raise the user's own Defence.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.0: Spread both wings and sweep the two flanks apart
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.1: Slide one wing edge along the edge of an enemy cluster
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.2: Hone Defence a little with every landed edge
Each side's wing edge deals about %1$s contact damage when it cuts a foe; each edge sweeps from straight ahead out to %2$s degrees, so the left and right edges touch independently.

Each edge reaches %1$s blocks from shoulder to tip; the first body or wall on the line is that edge's endpoint, and a landed edge shoves its target %2$s blocks away. Each target is hit at most once per cast.
After the first landed edge of the whole cast, a %1$s chance to harden the wing and raise the user's own Defence by %2$s stage; at most once per cast.
The wings take %1$s to unfold to full span with an edge contact radius of %2$s blocks; the untouched gap straight ahead between the two edges is not swept.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.glide.on: Gliding sweep: really slide forward first and keep both edges at full span while gliding, with a wider spread, more knockback and a steadier Defence raise, but slightly lower damage per edge and a longer windup and cooldown, plus a risk of sliding into the enemy line.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.glide.off: Grounded sweep: hold the ground and unfold the wings across your flanks; heavier per edge, faster with a shorter cooldown, and a slightly shorter spread.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: edge damage %2$s, up to %3$s Defence stage per cast.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.preference.g: On: really slide forward and keep both edges at full span while gliding, with a wider spread, more knockback and a steadier Defence raise, but slightly lower damage per edge and a longer windup and cooldown, plus a risk of sliding into the enemy line. Off (grounded): hold the ground and unfold the wings across your flanks; heavier per edge, faster with a shorter cooldown, and a slightly shorter spread.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.preference.a: Only unfold when the foe is within this range; a larger value means closing in on both flanks more willingly.
On: unfold when others are clustered around the target so both edges catch a flank. Off: rank it like ordinary melee.
On: while Defence is below +4 stages, rank the sweep higher to harden the wing before taking hits. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
